scope: Independent source review of receiver.py, campaign.py, bindings.py, selected electron_donor.py contracts and reused HE30 shared_runner.py. Scientific execution results require a separate result review.

findings.evidence: Lmax8 gives original4+4*9=40 physical states. y0 appends tau0; augmented_rhs passes only first40 to original model.rhs and appends GammaT*(Href/H)/Href=GammaT/H. tau does not enter physical RHS. Original model source and reconstructed diagnostics use target H; one moment evaluation per augmented RHS remains structurally valid.
findings.scope: Unpolarized scalar Thomson and prescribed one-way electron source, not bidirectional chemistry or polarization.

findings.evidence: q=Sigma_F/sqrt(6-Sigma_F²), source Sigma_ref=Sigma_F/sqrt2 and positive initial orientation reproduce Frobenius shear magnitude. Radiation A=5*P_r*(1+q²)/(sqrt6*f_r). Matter A=P_m/K_m with the pinned finite-quadrature amplitude1 calibration. This matches the existing D3 component adapter. Negative P_m/P_r are kept; normalization forms P_r=P_gamma+P_nu before abs and Pi_total=abs(P_m+P_r).
findings.limits: Initial shear orientation is the positive branch when Sigma_F>0, matching D3; signed evolution is subsequently retained.

findings.evidence: Off returnsNone before reading manifest/path and physical identity has donor_identity=None. On checks manifest bytes, data SHA/content identity through ElectronDonor.load, purpose for manufactured control and actual full interval support. No extrapolation; old20-to4 donor cannot be prepared as20-to2. Frozen donor cache is immutable and keyed by resolvedpath+expectedmanifestSHA.

findings.initial_issue: If VENDOR already existed later in sys.path, the initial loader did not move it to the front and checked module paths only before import. A different not-yet-imported canonical module could shadow the pinned file.
findings.resolution: Current bindings moves VENDOR to index0 and checks canonical_fv/species_hierarchy/lrs_boltzmann __file__ both before and after import. Cached c21k_scheduler/bass_resources provenance and newly resolved resource paths are checked too.
findings.verification: Static final source readback; root separately owns a fresh-process shadowed-PYTHONPATH check. Reviewer did not run a worker.

findings.initial_issue: All src files plus execution resource dependencies originally entered the scientific identity, invalidating physical results after unrelated plotting/scheduling changes.
findings.resolution: Current science digest names bindings.py,receiver.py,electron_donor.py,prepared_moments.py and four canonicalvendor physics/clock files. Runner/resource files remain baseline-verified and are stored separately under execution_resource_sha256. Campaign/plot/report edits are excluded.

findings.evidence: campaign.run loads the pinned HE30 runner under a distinct module name, api_module='receiver'. HE30 derives api_dir from receiver.__file__, includes HE31src and HE30src in childPYTHONPATH, and passes --_worker-module receiver. Child inherits absolute HE31_CAMPAIGN and thread1 environment, sets owned CPU affinity and imports receiver. API methods case_grid,case_identity,completed_result,write_case match the reused coordinator.

Completed receipts require canonical payloadSHA, matching scienceidentity/schema/completedstatus, nonempty alltrue gates, finite41x121 state, monotonic121 time points and declared endpoint. Existing invalid/failed/partial target files raise rather than overwrite. Atomic writes use replace=False via link. HE30 globalcase lock and CPUlease govern cooperating launches; invalid prior receipts remain preserved, and busycase does not stop other pending cases.
findings.limits: Receipt integrity/identity checks are not an independent numerical-result proof. Unrelated case filenames in the sameoutputdir are preserved; use distinct outputdirs for different prepared campaigns.

findings.initial_issue: Initial campaign CLI printed reports but returned implicit0 even forFAILED/DEFERRED/TIMED_OUT states.
findings.resolution: Current main returns2 when any real-run terminal status is outside COMPLETE/REUSED_COMPLETE; dryplan andsuccessfulpreparation return0; __main__ uses raiseSystemExit(main()).

findings.evidence: HE30 can reuse a completed case at a registry path outside the newly requested outputdirectory. It returns that path without materializing another casefile. Saved-result plotting/analysis must follow RUNNER_REPORT.statuses[case].path rather than assuming every complete case has a newlocalJSON.

After the uniform-grid floor estimate, scalar density now confirms x lies in the actual knotinterval and falls back to searchsorted otherwise. This addresses almost-uniform knot and binary64 log boundary selection without extrapolating or changing the physical donor.

findings.discovery: The root-owned first actual paired worker attempt failed during canonical JSON payload hashing because a NumPy boolean was not directly JSON serializable. Neither attempt produced a completed case receipt.
findings.resolution: Current run_case applies plain(result) before computing payload_sha256. NumPy numeric/bool scalar leaves use item(), numeric arrays use tolist(), and dict/list/tuple containers recurse. The actual result domain consists of these numeric/scalar/container types. Canonical JSON retains allow_nan=False; conversion does not admit nonfinite values. The physical RHS, tolerances, normalized axes and acceptance thresholds are unchanged by this correction.
findings.verification: Static current-source readback plus reuse of root SERIALIZATION_RECHECK.json, status PASS_SCOPED and ode_calls=0. Source import-order and post-import provenance checks were reread and remain present in unchanged bindings.py. Reviewer ran no new tests, workers or ODE.
findings.recovery: Original failures/logs/receipts remain in evidence/failed/serialization. Root chose a distinct corrected output directory, results/light_actual_pair_v2. Numerical admission of that paired attempt remains a separate result-review task.
